metadata.name: Margaret Thatcher
metadata.description: British prime minister assessed through her governing record, parliamentary conservatism, market reforms and defence policy.
metadata.scope: Personal positions and governing conduct during 1979–1990; earlier writings are contextual only. Historical analogies to contemporary technologies are explicitly inferred, not claims that the subject answered a modern questionnaire. Coalition constraints and contradictions are identified by axis.
